project_overview.concept: A digital sanctuary for high-end nail artistry. Merging editorial fashion aesthetics with modern brutalist minimalism.
project_overview.scope: Customer-facing marketing, appointment booking, and Stripe checkout. No admin dashboard.
project_overview.content: Use sample luxury salon data (name, address, phone, elegant service descriptions, standard prices).

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant - blending classic editorial elegance with sterile, modern geometry.

headings.rules: Must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px. Use font-light for elegance. Fluid typography for Hero (clamp up to text-6xl). Never center headings unless for poetic impact.

body.rules: Clean, highly legible geometry. leading-relaxed for paragraphs. Left aligned.

accent.usage: Overlines, labels, small UI elements, step indicators.

colors.strategy: Archetype 5: LUXURY. High contrast, rich, emotional, dark mode by default.
colors.rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Always use tinted darks. Primary CTA buttons should be the Accent color with dark text. Avoid generic full-screen gradients.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Break the typical tight UI container mold.
layouts_and_grids.portfolio_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix tall (col-span-4 row-span-2), square (col-span-4 row-span-1), and hero items. Never fill 100% perfectly; leave empty cells for tension.
layouts_and_grids.services_grid: Cardless list approach. Rows separated by subtle 1px bottom borders (border-[#2A2828]). Do not use standard white Box-Shadowed Cards.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Prioritize asymmetry. Build visual tension by floating text blocks off-center.

component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp rectangular (rounded-none) or subtle pill (rounded-full). Use group-hover utility classes for internal icon/text shifting animations. Accent color bg with #0F0E0E text for Primary CTAs.
component_guidelines.booking_flow: Immersive, multi-step flow (Service -> Stylist -> Date -> Time -> Payment). Avoid long scrolling forms. Use Shadcn Tabs or horizontal animated step containers.
component_guidelines.calendar: Shadcn Calendar for date selection. Override default styles to match Dark Luxury theme (dark bg, accent color for selected date, remove generic blue focus rings).
component_guidelines.forms: Inputs must have bg-transparent, border-b border-border, rounded-none, with focus:border-accent. No fully bordered input boxes. Pure HTML/Tailwind for layout, Shadcn logic.
component_guidelines.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism over Hero image. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F0E0E]/60 border-b border-white/5. Must contain Logo, Links, and 'Book Now' CTA. Never use completely transparent background.
component_guidelines.footer: Massive py-32 spacing. Darkest background. Giant text for the 'Book an Appointment' final CTA.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' strictly for Sticky Headers/Nav. Use 'Grid Borders' (Technical Look) for the pricing/services list to give it an architectural structure.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity-10, pointer-events-none, fixed to viewport) to kill digital flatness and feel more physical/editorial.
visual_enhancers.images: Hero overlay MUST NOT exceed bg-black/40. The image must be visible. If text contrast is low, use text-shadow or a soft radial gradient directly behind text.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Implement 'lenis' library for smooth momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for a premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Use Framer Motion. Staggered fade-up for services list. Subtle image scale (1.0 to 1.05) on scroll (parallax).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images in portfolio should have a slow brightness/contrast shift or scale transform on hover. Buttons should have a background color fill transition.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in on load using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #A6A19C against #0F0E0E meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text inside #C19277 buttons must be dark (#0F0E0E) for contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactable elements must have focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-accent outline-none.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-now-button', data-testid='service-select-item').

media_and_images.guidelines: Images must look like high-end editorial photography, not cheap stock. Use desaturated or warm-toned images to fit the dark luxury theme.

hero_background.description: Ambient, luxurious steam room lighting to set a calm, premium mood. Use with a 30% black overlay.

portfolio_1.description: Elegant hand with black/tortoiseshell patterned nails and gold ring.

abstract_art.description: Abstract elegant hands against a wall, used for a large banner or testimonial section background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js files) and Tailwind CSS. Do NOT use .tsx or TypeScript.
Initialize Shadcn UI for dropdowns, forms, and calendar, but deeply override the CSS to match the dark luxury theme and font families.
Install and setup @phosphor-icons/react for thin, elegant duotone or light-weight icons. Do not use generic thick icons.
Install lenis for smooth scrolling and framer-motion for UI transitions.
Implement the Stripe payment gateway checkout page and the entire appointment booking flow (Service -> Stylist -> Date -> Time -> Payment).
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' is applied via font-serif and 'Manrope' via font-sans. Verify they are loaded via Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections (Hero, Portfolio) to allow extreme asymmetrical layouts, do not rely entirely on rigid Shadcn Cards.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
